explanation: For every possible left-subtree size, recursively enumerate both subtree families and combine each left/right pair under a new root. Subtree objects may be shared among returned trees; the wrapper serializes their shapes.
timeComplexity: O(n·Cn) output-size upper bound, where Cn is the nth Catalan number
spaceComplexity: O(n·Cn) including returned structures and shape serialization
